Statement: Cashiers identify a member at the till when the QR code on the member's phone cannot be scanned.
Quote: Happens all the time with old phones.
Reason: Workarounds O1 and O2: 8 failed scans in 4 h observed, "every shift" reported. Cashiers asked for manual entry of the member number.

Statement: Points of a purchase whose member was not identified at the till can be added later from the receipt.
Quote: Support adds the points later if they call.
Reason: Workaround O2 (paper notepad): 4 entries in 4 h observed, about 15 this week. Related to CAN-011 (support finds a purchase by receipt number).

Statement: A voucher that the customer mobile app shows as active is accepted at the till.
Reason: Workaround O3 (manual discount with supervisor key): 2 in 4 h observed, "a few times a week" reported.

Statement: Purchases made while the till cannot reach the loyalty service earn their points when the connection returns.
Reason: Episode O4: 1 network drop observed, "maybe twice a week" reported; nothing queues the scans today.

Statement: Cashiers can tell a member when the points of a purchase will appear.
Reason: Workaround O5 (guessing): 3 in 4 h observed, "every shift" reported. Depends on the posting rule (CAN-002).
